title: Localization Dichotomy for Hall Insulators on the Lattice
summary: We prove the localization dichotomy conjecture for non-periodic Hall insulators on the lattice. That is, we show that the Fermi projector $P$ of a gapped exponentially local Hamiltonian on $l^2(\mathbb{Z}^2) \otimes \mathbb{C}^n$ admits an exponentially localized Wannier basis if and only if $P$ has vanishing Chern number.
